name: Perplexity
promptStyle: Research-focused queries specifying search scope, time windows, domain authorities, comparative criteria, and citation standards.
principles: Frame a clear, concise primary research question suitable for real-time web retrieval.
State explicit temporal constraints (e.g. latest 2025-2026 data, historical range).
Specify authoritative domain preferences (e.g. peer-reviewed, official documentation, regulatory filings).
Define comparative axes and evidence metrics for syntheses.
Require inline source citations and separation of factual consensus from opinion.

rules.title: Define Clear Temporal and Geographic Scope
rules.description: Specify time windows (e.g., current year, recent changes) and regional boundaries so the search engine queries the most relevant live indices.

rules.title: Enforce Strict Citation & Source Grounding
rules.description: Demand numbered in-text citations linked to verified URLs, and mandate flagging conflicting reports across sources.

rules.title: Structured Comparative Synthesis
rules.description: Request structured Markdown tables comparing alternatives across cost, performance, timeline, and trade-offs.
rules.sourceTitle: Perplexity Best Practices for Technical Research

contextStrategy: Treat user background context as an initial hypothesis or baseline, and instruct Perplexity to verify and augment it with current public web sources.
outputGuidance: Synthesize findings into an Executive Summary, Detailed Breakdown with Citations, Comparison Matrix, and Remaining Uncertainties.

references.title: Perplexity Help Center & Search Documentation
references.whyRelevant: Official guidance on how Perplexity searches the web, balances sources, and formats citations.
